test_cases.description: The App component must render the #app-shell div as a descendant inside the BrowserRouter context, ensuring routing context is available to all children
test_cases.input_description: Render App component and verify routing context is available within #app-shell
test_cases.expected_output_description: A hook like useLocation should work inside the app-shell div, proving BrowserRouter wraps it
assertions: div#app-shell is inside a Router context

test_cases.description: The App export must be a callable React function component, not a pre-rendered element or object literal
test_cases.input_description: Import App and check its type
test_cases.expected_output_description: App should be a function that can be called as a React component

test_cases.description: The scaffold App component should render an empty app-shell div with no page content, route definitions, or layout — those belong to downstream components
test_cases.input_description: Render App and inspect the #app-shell div contents
test_cases.expected_output_description: The app-shell div should be empty or contain no meaningful page content
assertions: #app-shell has no child elements or is minimal

test_cases.description: Calling App as a component must return a valid React element (not null, undefined, or a string)
test_cases.input_description: Call App() or render <App /> and check the return value
test_cases.expected_output_description: A valid ReactElement object

test_cases.description: The App component should produce the same DOM structure on repeated renders, ruling out randomized or stateful hardcoded shortcuts
test_cases.input_description: Render App twice in separate containers
test_cases.expected_output_description: Both renders have a div#app-shell inside router context
assertions: Two independent renders produce identical DOM structure

test_cases.description: mountApp must use the React 18 createRoot API from react-dom/client, not the legacy ReactDOM.render
test_cases.input_description: Mock react-dom/client and verify createRoot is invoked
test_cases.expected_output_description: createRoot should be called with the #root element

test_cases.description: mountApp must render the App component (not some other component or raw HTML) into the root
test_cases.input_description: Execute mountApp with mocked DOM and verify App is what gets rendered
test_cases.expected_output_description: The rendered tree should contain App's BrowserRouter and #app-shell structure
assertions: The rendered content includes App's output structure

test_cases.description: index.html must contain a div element with id='root' as the React mount point
test_cases.expected_output_description: The file contains a div with id root

test_cases.description: index.html must reference /src/main.tsx as a module script, which is the Vite entry point
test_cases.expected_output_description: A script tag with type=module and src=/src/main.tsx

test_cases.description: postcss.config.js must include both tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins for the CSS pipeline to work
test_cases.expected_output_description: Both tailwindcss and autoprefixer are listed as plugins

test_cases.description: src/test-setup.ts must import @testing-library/jest-dom to register custom DOM matchers globally for all tests
test_cases.expected_output_description: The file imports @testing-library/jest-dom

test_cases.description: react-dom must be listed as a runtime dependency with a caret-pinned ^18.x version, not just react alone
test_cases.expected_output_description: react-dom version matches ^18.x pattern

test_cases.description: react-router-dom must be listed as a runtime dependency with a caret-pinned version
test_cases.expected_output_description: react-router-dom exists with caret-pinned version

test_cases.description: vercel.json must contain exactly one rewrite rule in a rewrites array, not multiple or zero rules
test_cases.expected_output_description: The rewrites array contains exactly one rule object

test_cases.description: tailwind.config.js content array must include BOTH './index.html' AND './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' — not just one of them
test_cases.input_description: Import tailwind.config.js and inspect content array
test_cases.expected_output_description: Both glob patterns are present in the content array

test_cases.description: vite.config.ts must use the @vitejs/plugin-react plugin so JSX transformation works correctly
test_cases.expected_output_description: The plugins array contains the react() plugin
assertions: vite config plugins array includes react plugin

test_cases.description: src/index.css must contain exactly the three Tailwind directives in order — @tailwind base, components, utilities — with no extra CSS rules
test_cases.expected_output_description: Exactly three @tailwind directives and nothing else significant

test_cases.description: The App module must not have a default export even if it has a named App export — checking that 'default' key is absent from module namespace
test_cases.input_description: Dynamic import of the App module to inspect all exports
test_cases.expected_output_description: The module namespace has App but no default property
assertions: module.App is defined and is a function

test_cases.description: The vitest config block must contain all three fields (environment, globals, setupFiles) simultaneously — not just individually correct values
test_cases.expected_output_description: A single test config object with all three correct fields
assertions: all three present in same config object

test_cases.description: tsconfig.json compilerOptions must contain all four required fields simultaneously — strict, jsx, moduleResolution, isolatedModules
test_cases.expected_output_description: All four fields present with correct values in the same compilerOptions object
assertions: all four present in same object

test_cases.description: @testing-library/jest-dom must be in devDependencies with a caret-pinned version — this is distinct from @testing-library/react
test_cases.expected_output_description: @testing-library/jest-dom present with caret version
